content: Wila̱ adama e tsipere
Reve A̱sulazuva a damma Musa,
<<Yuwan adanshi na aza a Isra'ila vu damma le: a̱mu ɗa A̱sulazuva A̱sula̱ a̱ ɗu.

She i yuwan cine aa yuwusan a̱tsuma̱ a Masar wan, uba̱ta̱ u na i da̱na̱i na̱ nden. Waru she i yuwan cine aa yuwusan a̱tsuma̱ e iɗa ya Ka'ana wan, uba̱ta̱ u na ma̱a̱ ta̱wa̱to ɗu. She i yuwan cine ele aa yuwusan wan.
I toni wila̱ u va̱ reve i kuru ili i na n dammai ulobonu. A̱mu ɗa A̱sulazuva A̱sula̱ a̱ ɗu.
I toni ili i na n dammai na̱ wila̱ u va̱, adama a na vuma na toniyi nle u ta̱ tsura̱ wuma e ekere e le. A̱mu ɗa A̱sulazuva.
<<She i yuwan zuzu ni imaci i na i ri zuzu na̱ a̱ɗu na yoo von ne ele wan. A̱mu ɗa A̱sulazuva.
She vu von na̱ mma va̱ wu vu zuwa dada va̱ wu o'wo ili yi izo'oshi wan. Mma va̱ wu ɗa. She vu von na̱ a̱yi wan.
She vu von na̱ ka va dada va̱ wu wan, ili i ndolo i ta zuwa dada va̱ wu o'wo ili yi izo'oshi.

She vu von na̱ mawun ma̱ a̱na̱wu ma̱ wu mo usheli wan, ko mawun ma̱ a̱sha̱wu ma̱ wu mo usheli wan, ko mawun mo usheli ma mma va̱ wu wan, ko o u'wa u ta̱ u ɗa a matsan nɗu ko a matsan yi ta̱ uba̱ta̱ u ro.
She vu von na̱ mawun ma tsukaya ma̱ wu usheli wu ulobo wa̱ wu wan, ko usheli wu usheli wa̱ wu wan, ili i ndolo i to o'wo wu ili yi izo'oshi.
She vu von nu usheli wu ka va dada va̱ wu za na a matsaan niyi wan, mawun ma̱ a̱sha̱wu ma̱ wu ma ɗa.
She vu von na̱ mawun ma̱ a̱na̱wu ma dada va̱ wu mo usheli wan, adama a na maci zuzu va dada va̱ wu ɗa.
She vu von na̱ mawun ma̱ a̱na̱wu ma mma va̱ wu mo usheli wan, adama a na maci zuzu va mma va̱ wu ɗa.
She vu von na̱ ka mawun ma̱ a̱na̱wu ma dada va̱ wu wan, adama a na a̱yi mma va̱ wu ɗa.
She vu von na̱ jene va̱ wu wan, ka mawun ma̱ wu ma ɗa. She vu von na̱ a̱yi wan.
She vu von na̱ ka mawun ma̱ a̱na̱wu ma̱ wu wan, adama a na ili i nda i to o'wo yi ili yi izo'oshi.
She vu von na̱ mma oɓolo nu usheli wa̱ yi wan. Waru she vu von na̱ mawun ma tsukaya ma̱ yi usheli wu ulobo wa̱ yi ko mo usheli wa̱ yi wan, adama a na imaci i zuzu ya̱ yi i ɗa. Iwuya i ɗa ndolo'o.
She vu zuwa zawa'a vu ka va̱ wu wo o'wo shewun va̱ yi ka va̱ wu gba ubuwu wuma, a̱vu vu von na̱ a̱yi wan.
<<She vu von na̱ ka a̱yi a mantsa mo usumbu ma̱ yi wan.
She vu von na̱ ka moron ma̱ nden ma̱ wu, a̱vu vu lungusa̱ aciya̱wu na̱ a̱yi wan.
She vu yuwan kucci na̱ ko mawun ma̱ ta̱ a̱tsuma̱ a̱ muwun ma̱ wu e ekere a̱ a̱a̱ma̱li Mole wan, adama vu ta̱wa̱a̱ na̱ wono e ekere a̱ A̱sulazuva wan. A̱mu ɗa A̱sulazuva.
She vu von na̱ vali na̱ vali cine a tsu yuwan na̱ ka wan. Ili yi idaba i ɗa e ekere a̱ A̱sulazuva.
She vu von na̱ nama wan a̱vu vu lungusa̱ aciya̱wu. She ka ca lipu va̱ yi nama von na̱ a̱yi wan, ili yi idaba i ɗa.
<<A̱tsuma̱ e re nda suru she i lungusa̱ aciya̱ɗu wan, adama a na tsundolo tsa ɗa ama a na moo lo a̱ ma̱ka̱ka̱n ma̱ ɗu o o'woi ili yi idaba.
Tsundolo tsa ɗa iɗa'a yo o'woi idaba. Reve n ca yi oforo adama o unusu wa̱ yi, adama o ndolo a ɗaɗa iɗa'a i shaamai aza a na a̱ ri pe nden.
Amma i to toni ili i na n dammai na̱ wila̱ u va̱ agba she i yuwan ili yi idaba i nda wan, ko umatsun wi iɗa i ɗa vu ri ko mocin na ri nden na̱ a̱ɗu,
adama a na ili i nda i ɗa suru ama'a a yuwain aza a na a̱ da̱na̱i elime a̱ ɗu, reve iɗa'a yo o'wo idaba.
Na̱ yo o'woto iɗa'a ili yi idaba, u ta shaama ɗu cine u shaamai ama a na a̱ shi elime a̱ ɗu.
Vuma na yuwain cu'un vi ili yi idaba i nda suru, cu'un vuma ndolo a tawa yi a̱tsuma̱ a ama yi.
I toni ili i na n dammai, she i yuwan ili yi idaba ya agadu ya ama a na a yuwusain kafu i ta̱wa̱ pa wan. Waru she i lungusa̱ aciya̱ɗu ne ele wan. A̱mu ɗa A̱sulazuva A̱sula̱ a̱ ɗu.>>
